delay_mimicry_only.description: Adversary manipulates request intervals and rates only

full_feature_mimicry.description: Adversary shapes timing, rate, and packet size distributions

vulnerability_analysis: Statistical L4/L7 flow features (inter-arrival intervals, request rates, packet sizes) can be manipulated by a sophisticated adversary to mimic benign human distributions. While timing manipulation partially fools the Random Forest classifier, the Isolation Forest and hybrid verdict engine flag anomalies or disagreements as 'Suspicious'.

recommended_countermeasures.feature: TCP Window Size & Initial Congestion Window Dynamics
recommended_countermeasures.rationale: Real OS TCP stacks (Linux, Windows, iOS) follow distinct congestion control window trajectories that synthetic socket bots rarely match.

recommended_countermeasures.feature: TLS Client Hello Fingerprinting (JA3 / JA4 / Cipher Suites)
recommended_countermeasures.rationale: Python requests/urllib TLS fingerprint differs drastically from real modern browsers (Chrome/Firefox/Safari TLS extensions, GREASE).
Automated payload generators exhibit repeated patterns and non-standard HTTP/2 header sequences.
Physical input events (bezier-curve mouse velocity, keystroke flight times) are orthogonal to network packet timings.
